candidates.authorityName: California Department of Fish and Wildlife
candidates.summary: Open January 1 through March 31 within a 200-yard radius of the mouth.

candidates.authorityName: California Department of Fish and Wildlife
candidates.summary: Only artificial lures with barbless hooks may be used, within 200 yards of the mouth.

candidates.authorityName: California Department of Fish and Wildlife

parameters.counting_rule: Applies only to hatchery (adipose-fin-clipped) trout or steelhead; combined daily bag of 2, combined possession limit of 4.

candidates.summary: 2 hatchery trout or hatchery steelhead daily bag; 4 in possession, within 200 yards of the mouth.

candidates.authorityName: California Department of Fish and Wildlife
candidates.summary: Open the fourth Saturday in May through March 31, from 200 yards above the mouth to the mouth of Prairie Creek.

candidates.authorityName: California Department of Fish and Wildlife

parameters.note: Barbless hooks required, but bait is allowed (unlike Reaches A and C, which restrict tackle to artificial lures only).

candidates.summary: Only barbless hooks may be used (bait permitted), from 200 yards above the mouth to the mouth of Prairie Creek.

candidates.authorityName: California Department of Fish and Wildlife

parameters.counting_rule: Applies only to hatchery (adipose-fin-clipped) trout or steelhead; combined daily bag of 2, combined possession limit of 4.

candidates.summary: 2 hatchery trout or hatchery steelhead daily bag; 4 in possession, from 200 yards above the mouth to the mouth of Prairie Creek.

candidates.authorityName: California Department of Fish and Wildlife
candidates.summary: Open the fourth Saturday in May through March 31, from the mouth of Prairie Creek to the mouth of Bond Creek.

candidates.authorityName: California Department of Fish and Wildlife
candidates.summary: Only artificial lures with barbless hooks may be used, from the mouth of Prairie Creek to the mouth of Bond Creek.

candidates.authorityName: California Department of Fish and Wildlife

parameters.counting_rule: Applies only to hatchery (adipose-fin-clipped) trout or steelhead; combined daily bag of 2, combined possession limit of 4.

candidates.summary: 2 hatchery trout or hatchery steelhead daily bag; 4 in possession, from the mouth of Prairie Creek to the mouth of Bond Creek.

candidates.authorityName: California Department of Fish and Wildlife

parameters.note: Redwood Creek and all tributaries upstream of (above) the mouth of Bond Creek, within Redwood National Park, are closed to all fishing year-round to protect headwater rearing and spawning habitat for steelhead, coastal cutthroat trout, and salmon.

candidates.summary: Redwood Creek and tributaries above the mouth of Bond Creek are closed to all fishing all year.

candidates.authorityName: California Department of Fish and Wildlife

parameters.note: Only hatchery trout or steelhead showing a healed adipose fin clip may be retained in Reaches A, B, and C; wild (unclipped) trout or steelhead must be released immediately.

candidates.summary: Wild (unclipped) trout and steelhead must be released immediately; only adipose-fin-clipped hatchery fish count toward the bag.

candidates.authorityName: California Department of Fish and Wildlife

parameters.description: Also see 14 CCR §8.00(a) — Low-Flow Restrictions, which may impose additional emergency closures on this water when streamflow drops below regulatory thresholds.

candidates.summary: Low-flow restrictions under §8.00(a) may additionally close or restrict fishing on Redwood Creek during periods of low streamflow.

candidates.authorityName: California Department of Fish and Wildlife

parameters.note: Anglers 16 years of age or older must have a valid California sport fishing license.

candidates.summary: California sport fishing license required for anglers 16+
